theorems.name: Submission.doraggt_lipschitz_graph_map_basics
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (b : Euclid (n + k)) (g : Euclid n → Euclid k) (L : NNReal), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → LipschitzWith L g → (∀ u u' : Euclid n, dist u u' ≤ dist (b + ι u + ι' (g u)) (b + ι u' + ι' (g u'))) ∧ LipschitzWith (1 + L) (fun u => b + ι u + ι' (g u)) ∧ IsClosed (Set.range fun u => b + ι u + ι' (g u)) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid (n + k)), IsCompact K → μHE[n] (Set.range (fun u => b + ι u + ι' (g u)) ∩ K) ≠ ∞) ∧ ∀ N : Set (Euclid n), volume N = 0 → μHE[n] ((fun u => b + ι u + ι' (g u)) '' N) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
